summary: Trivial __thiscall getter that returns the dword at this+0x4 (element index 1 of the this dword array). Reads no globals, takes no guards, and makes no calls.

operations.description: Return the dword stored at this[1], the dword at byte offset 0x4 of the this object.

unresolved: Object type and meaning of the field at this+0x4 are unknown; the caller set spans unrelated subsystems.
